inclusion_criteria: The subject is a public Python repository with a documented permissive license.
The selected head commit changes production Python code and has a distinct parent commit.
The test command is explicit, reproducible, and suitable for execution in a prebuilt trusted image.
Selection rationale and every revision are recorded before interpreting results.

subjects.selection_rationale: Calibration subject for checking the manifest, report schema, and controlled runner before collecting third-party study results.
